adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/embed_controller.rb#best`, when no `topic_id` is found it does `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading`; it never calls `TopicRetriever.new` directly. The spec `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` (the test named “tells the topic retriever to work when no previous embed is found”) instead mocks `TopicRetriever.new` and expects `retriever.retrieve`, which is inconsistent with the controller behavior unless a job system runs inline. The review finding correctly identifies a diff-grounded issue in the test expectations rather than a production defect.
